We must find a way to stop Godzilla! Head east along the road through the forest. The army had a post up in the mountains north of Cedar Harbor, at the far end of it. Get there before the blood moon and hole up there for the night: when the horde is done he comes in from the sea and destroys the city at dawn, and you will see it all from up there. Then take the pass north before the radiation catches you.\n\nThe Duke

That is every part. Build the Oxygen Destroyer at a workbench (with 10 electrical parts and 20 forged steel), place it on the shore in front of Ashmouth where he comes out of the sea, and arm it before the last blood moon ends. If he comes within 100 m of it, he dies.
